description:
🏡 Did you know? A recent study found 45% of homeowners regret their purchase.

❓ Why? Most buyers underestimate the true cost of owning a home.

Many focus only on:
💰 Down payment
💸 Monthly mortgage

…but forget the ongoing expenses:
📈 Property taxes
🏠 Rising insurance premiums
🛠️ Regular home maintenance
💡 Higher utility bills
🚰 Surprise repairs (like a $7,000 water heater 😱)
🏘️ HOA fees
🛋️ Unplanned upgrades & improvements

These hidden costs can add up fast, creating unexpected stress!

✅ How to avoid it:
Before buying, map out a realistic monthly budget that includes all the extras — not just the mortgage. This helps you step into homeownership with clarity & confidence! 💪
